checks.note: ERP, payments and Slack use runtime STS token exchange (identity.py). Slack signing and mail HMAC are inbound verification secrets mounted from k8s Secrets, not outbound credentials. No static-key fallback found.
The workload token is bounded to 600s and STS expires_in is honoured (identity.py:115). STS token lifetime and rotation of the Slack, mail HMAC and Anthropic secrets are set outside this repo.

STS tokens are sent as plain bearer tokens with no DPoP or mTLS in the repo. They are audience-bound and short-lived. Whether the STS or gateways support holder binding is not stated in the repo.
